propositions: rebar must support s3:// URLs as ticket-store remotes using git-remote-s3, keeping identical git event data format and auto-commit/push flow with data encrypted at rest via SSE-KMS

concurrent pushes can create multiple bundle files for one ref, causing git ls-remote to return divergent SHAs and fresh clones to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed', making the store unclonable

when sync.remote is s3:// and git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below minimum version 0.3.2, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the exact pip install command
the multiple-bundles state must self-heal non-interactively by merge-based reconciliation, leaving exactly one bundle per ref with all commits from all divergent heads reachable from the healed tip
